g.text: Two attention blocks carry part of Lightning's lookup, not all of it

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Share of the whole change's switches cut when later tokens cannot attend; dashed 0.6, dotted 0.3
Lightning hollow: its gate chosen after its 60-scene pre-check was seen. Rule fixed in advance: two blocks if
both cut the lookup's switches by at least 0.6 and the control by at most 0.15; not through attention if every
attention block after L cuts under 0.3; both runs: in between.
The span: every token after the scene cannot attend to the span from the bridge word to the scene's end; the
control span: as long, ending before the bridge's sentence, on the 83 of 200 scenes where it fits. The 9B, 27B
and Muse: not applicable; the 122B: not run.
